latestVersion.changelog:
Negotiation One Sheet Generator v1.0.0

- First release of a comprehensive negotiation preparation tool based on "Never Split the Difference."
- Produces a five-section Negotiation One Sheet covering: aspirational goal, situation summary, accusation audit, calibrated questions, and noncash offers.
- Works in standalone mode with inline processes, or in integrated mode by utilizing outputs from seven supporting Level 0 skills.
- Designed for anyone preparing for high-stakes negotiations (sales, contracts, salaries, etc.); no formal negotiation training required.
- Outputs a complete negotiation-one-sheet.md document ready for immediate use.
